verdict.rationale: Bolna documents an official CLI, a single Go binary named `bolna`, for managing agents, calls, phone numbers, and batches from the terminal. A probe independently confirms the CLI documentation page exists. Missing for 10: detailed command-reference evidence, AI-native affordances such as machine-readable or JSON output and agent-friendly scripting, and independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: The Bolna CLI (bolna) is a single Go binary that lets you manage agents, calls, phone numbers, and batches directly from your terminal
